purpose: One prospective independent hosted owning-stage replication per native candidate after local identical-code control variation exceeded the possible effect. Local results remain retained and inconclusive, not replaced or pooled.
runtime: Pinned repository Node 22.22.0 on Ubuntu 26.04; a separate environment from local Node 24.22.3. No browser or complete-import inference from these component runs.

strict-field-delimiter.cohort: Six balanced ABC permutations;18 fresh processes; each has one cold 12-group JMdict pass,8 excluded warmups and one warm 12-group pass. A/C are identical baseline. Resident decoded source through native parser and completed lookup; archive inflation/compilation/oracles/GC are outside timing.

crc-powers.cohort: Six fresh processes replay all 170 production VNDB verifier inputs in group/pass-balanced ABC orders. A/C share identical baseline module bytes. Native verifier call only; source parser/inflate/copies/oracles/checkpoint I/O/compilation are outside timing.

retention: Retain every planned observation, cold/compile/init/heap control, checkpoint, raw failure and tail. No outlier removal, control subtraction, source retuning or additional repeats chosen after these results.
decision: Assess each candidate against both baselines and its own control spread. This does not grant browser speed or memory qualification. PR decision remains separate and requires a gain worth reviewing.
